item.title: Hanover Police Service briefs
item.description: Break and enter On Sept. 20, 2025, at 3:20 a.m., Hanover officers responded to a break and enter in progress to a cannabis retail outlet on 10th Street in Hanover. Responding officers determined three male suspects, while wearing disguises, had forced entry through a front door and stole cannabis products valued at more than $10,000. […]

item.title: West Grey turns out to see its new police station Saturday
item.description: The new police station meets today’s policing standards and allows officers to provide the best service possible to the community, West Grey Police Chief Jeremy White said.

item.title: Walkerton District Riverhawks punch ticket to OFSAA
